schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Majors are listed on the Dependency Dashboard and only open a PR once a maintainer approves them there
Group every non-major npm bump (dependencies, devDependencies, optionalDependencies) into one PR
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR
Group every runtime/tooling version pin (.tool-versions, mise, .node-version, .nvmrc) into one PR
Keep node and the package manager in lockstep with the pin files above: engines.node, volta and the packageManager field join the tooling PR
@types/node tracks the Node line, so its major and minor bumps ride the tooling PR. Patches ship several times a week and stay in the npm PR so they don't churn tooling.
